svg.title: Physician preference by core oncology field
svg.desc: Panel A reports overall and field specific raw counts. Panel B shows seven complete preference distributions including ties. Panel C shows seven adjusted harness preference probabilities and 95 percent confidence intervals; no overall adjusted point is shown.
